scope: Source-only study scoring of nine blinded submissions; not a measured AI-review-efficacy experiment.
method: Read only TASK.md and initial-src/final-src under this directory. No tests, network access, source modifications, or external package inspection. Counts are final-source application SQL definitions and distinct static db.prepare sites; transaction controls excluded. Empty initial TODO strings are not application SQL definitions. Subsequent clarification used only the supplied frozen public API declaration and runtime implementation, without execution.
causality: Treatment, outcomes, coder answers, motives and timing are unavailable; no causal or gate-appeasement inference made.
